variant.title: Consecutive Sudoku
variant.description: Only explicitly marked orthogonal edges require a digit difference of 1.
rule.consecutive: The cells joined by a marked edge must differ by 1.
rule_guide.title: Consecutive Sudoku Rules
rule_guide.item_1: Each row, column, and 3×3 box must contain no repeated digit.
rule_guide.item_2: The two cells joined by a marked orthogonal edge must differ by 1.
rule_guide.item_3: Unmarked adjacent edges add no extra restriction.
